turnos.t: The linear economy is take, make, use, dispose. The circular economy, promoted by the Ellen MacArthur Foundation, aims to eliminate waste, keep products and materials in use, and regenerate nature, decoupling economic activity from finite resources.

The biological cycle returns biodegradable materials safely to nature. The technical cycle keeps metals, plastics and electronics in the economy. Inner loops like share, repair and reuse keep more value than recycling, which is the last option. And the key link for any to-what-extent answer: the four models are complementary. The doughnut uses the planetary boundaries as its ceiling, and circular strategies help achieve the SDGs.
